mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.1% consistently compresses equity discount rates through cheap financing, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to valuation support for risk assets.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points over three months signals labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumer spending capacity.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE rises by >0.5pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) from prior month indicate broad consumer demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced corporate revenue expectations.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes (INDPRO > 105), a decline in industrial production from prior month signals overcapacity and slowing output, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO > 105 and INDPRO declines from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A rising housing starts trend (HOUST increasing from prior month) consistently reflects strong consumer confidence and construction activity, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when HOUST rises from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained consumer price index increase exceeding 0.2 percentage points over three months signals inflationary pressures that prompt monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises by >0.2% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous payroll growth (PAYEMS increasing from prior month) and unemployment rate decline (UNRATE decreasing from prior month) indicate robust labor market conditions, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when PAYEMS grows and UNRATE declines from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: In early-cycle expansion regimes (INDPRO < 100), a rising industrial production trend (INDPRO increasing from prior month) signals economic recovery momentum, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO < 100 and INDPRO rises from prior month.
